rem Sums of Digit Factorials
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=254
rem f(n) is the sum of the factorials of
rem the digits of n and sf(n) the digit
rem sum of f(n). With g(i) the least n
rem with sf(n) = i and sg(i) its digit
rem sum, add up sg(i) for i up to Top.

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Top integer = 150

rem A least n has at most d of the digit
rem d below 9, as d + 1 of them could be
rem swapped for a (d + 1) with the same
rem factorial sum. So f is written in
rem the factorial base, with all the
rem rest in 9s: c9 = f // 9!. The digits
rem are fewest for the least f with
rem digit sum i, up to 36 more than c9.
rem So look at the f with digit sum i
rem while c9 does not pass the best
rem count, each next one found by
rem raising the lowest digit that may
rem rise, and take the shortest n, the
rem least on ties, with digits in order.
Fa = array 1 1 2 6 24 120 720 5040
Fb = array 40320 362880
Fa = concat Fa Fb
Pw = 10 ** (0 to 22 array)
Dd = 0 to 9 array
Total = 0
for I in 1 to Top
  Q = I // 9
  Tn = 10 ** Q
  Low = (I mod 9) * Tn + Tn - 1
  Bk = 0
  Bc = array shape 10 fill 0
  F = Low
  for
    Cn = F // 362880
    if Bk greater 0 and Cn greater Bk
      break
    end
    C = array shape 10 fill 0
    C 9 = F // 362880
    Rm = F mod 362880
    for D in 8 to 1 by -1
      C D = Rm // (Fa D)
      Rm = Rm mod (Fa D)
    end
    K = C sum
    Pick = Bk equal 0 or K less Bk
    if K equal Bk
      for D in 1 to 9
        if C D equal Bc D
          continue
        end
        Pick = C D greater Bc D
        break
      end
    end
    if Pick
      Bk = K
      Bc = C
    end
    Dg = F // Pw mod 10
    Sb = 0
    for P in 1 to 22
      Sb += Dg (P - 1)
      if Dg P less 9 and Sb at least 1
        S = Sb - 1
        M = S // 9
        Tn = 10 ** M
        Tail = (S mod 9) * Tn + Tn - 1
        Pp = Pw P
        F = (F // Pp + 1) * Pp + Tail
        break
      end
    end
  end
  Total += (Bc * Dd) sum
end
Answer = Total
Answer print

Fb = array 40320 362880
Fa = concat Fa Fb
Total = 0
for I in 1 to Top
  Total += I score Fa
end
Answer = Total
Answer print

fun I score Fa
  Sg = 0
  Q = I // 9
  Tn = 1
  for E in 1 to Q
    Tn *= 10
  end
  Low = (I mod 9) * Tn + Tn - 1
  Bk = 0
  Bc = array shape 10 fill 0
  F = Low
  for
    Cn = F // 362880
    if Bk greater 0 and Cn greater Bk
      break
    end
    C = array shape 10 fill 0
    C 9 = F // 362880
    K = C 9
    Rm = F mod 362880
    for D in 8 to 1 by -1
      C D = Rm // (Fa D)
      K += C D
      Rm = Rm mod (Fa D)
    end
    Pick = Bk equal 0 or K less Bk
    if K equal Bk
      for D in 1 to 9
        if C D equal Bc D
          continue
        end
        Pick = C D greater Bc D
        break
      end
    end
    if Pick
      Bk = K
      for D in 1 to 9
        Bc D = C D
      end
    end
    Dg = F
    Pp = 1
    Sb = 0

      Dg = Dg // 10
      Pp *= 10

        S = Sb - 1
        M = S // 9
        Tn = 1
        for E in 1 to M
          Tn *= 10
        end
        Tail = (S mod 9) * Tn + Tn - 1
        F = (F // Pp + 1) * Pp + Tail
        break
      end
    end
  end
  for D in 1 to 9
    Sg += D * Bc D
  end
  return Sg

rem Sums of Digit Factorials
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=254
use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli
arg Top integer = 150

Fa = array 1 1 2 6 24 120 720 5040
Fa = concat Fa (array 40320 362880)
Length = array 0
Digit = array 0
Order = array 0
for D in 1 to 8
  R = 0 till (Fa (D + 1)) array
  Q = R // (Fa D)
  Rest = R mod (Fa D)
  Length = (Length Rest) + Q
  Digit = (Digit Rest) + D * Q
  Order = (Order Rest) + Q * 10 ** (8 - D)
end
Total = 0
for I in 1 to Top
  Total += I score Length Digit Order
end
Answer = Total
Answer print

fun I score Length Digit Order
  Tn = 1
  for E in 1 to (I // 9)
    Tn *= 10
  end
  F = (I mod 9) * Tn + Tn - 1
  Bk = 0
  Best = 0
  Sg = 0
  for
    Cn = F // 362880
    if Bk greater 0 and Cn greater Bk
      break
    end
    Rm = F mod 362880
    K = Cn + Length Rm
    Key = Order Rm
    if Bk equal 0 or K less Bk or (K equal Bk and Key greater Best)
      Bk = K
      Best = Key
      Sg = 9 * Cn + Digit Rm
    end
    Dg = F
    Pp = 1
    Sb = 0
    for P in 1 to 22
      Sb += Dg mod 10
      Dg = Dg // 10
      Pp *= 10
      if Dg mod 10 less 9 and Sb at least 1
        S = Sb - 1
        Tn = 1
        for E in 1 to (S // 9)
          Tn *= 10
        end
        Tail = (S mod 9) * Tn + Tn - 1
        F = (F // Pp + 1) * Pp + Tail
        break
      end
    end
  end
  return Sg
end

rem Sums of Digit Factorials
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=254
rem f(n) is the sum of the factorials of
rem the digits of n and sf(n) the digit
rem sum of f(n). With g(i) the least n
rem with sf(n) = i and sg(i) its digit
rem sum, add up sg(i) for i up to Top.

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Top integer = 150

rem A least n has at most d of the digit
rem d below 9, as d + 1 of them could be
rem swapped for a (d + 1) with the same
rem factorial sum. So f is written in
rem the factorial base, with all the
rem rest in 9s: c9 = f // 9!. The digits
rem are fewest for the least f with
rem digit sum i, up to 36 more than c9.
rem So look at the f with digit sum i
rem while c9 does not pass the best
rem count, each next one found by
rem raising the lowest digit that may
rem rise, and take the shortest n, the
rem least on ties, with digits in order.
Fa = array 1 1 2 6 24 120 720 5040
Fb = array 40320 362880
Fa = concat Fa Fb
Dd = 0 to 9 array
rem Cache canonical digit counts for the
rem 9! possible remainders. Most F cannot
rem improve the current length: decode
rem their digits only when they can.
Length = Fa factorial_lengths
Total = 0
for I in 1 to Top
  Total += I digit_factorial_score Fa Dd Length
end
Answer = Total
Answer print

fun I digit_factorial_score Fa Dd Length
  Sg = 0
  Q = I // 9
  Tn = 1
  for E in 1 to Q
    Tn *= 10
  end
  Low = (I mod 9) * Tn + Tn - 1
  Bk = 0
  Bc = array shape 10 fill 0
  rem Reuse C; copy only a new best value.
  C = array shape 10 fill 0
  F = Low
  for
    Cn = F // 362880
    if Bk greater 0 and Cn greater Bk
      break
    end
    Rm = F mod 362880
    K = Cn + Length Rm
    if Bk equal 0 or K at most Bk
      C 9 = Cn
      for D in 8 to 1 by -1
        C D = Rm // (Fa D)
        Rm = Rm mod (Fa D)
      end
      Pick = Bk equal 0 or K less Bk
      if K equal Bk
        for D in 1 to 9
          if C D equal Bc D
            continue
          end
          Pick = C D greater Bc D
          break
        end
      end
      if Pick
        Bk = K
        Bc = C copy
        Sg = (C * Dd) sum
      end
    end
    Dg = F
    Pp = 1
    Sb = 0
    for P in 1 to 22
      Sb += Dg mod 10
      Dg = Dg // 10
      Pp *= 10
      if Dg mod 10 less 9 and Sb at least 1
        S = Sb - 1
        M = S // 9
        Tn = 1
        for E in 1 to M
          Tn *= 10
        end
        Tail = (S mod 9) * Tn + Tn - 1
        F = (F // Pp + 1) * Pp + Tail
        break
      end
    end
  end
  return Sg
end

rem At stage D, quotient gives the count
rem of digit D and the remainder indexes
rem the already computed lower digits.
fun Fa factorial_lengths
  Length = array 0
  for D in 1 to 8
    R = 0 till (Fa (D + 1)) array
    Q = R // (Fa D)
    Rest = R mod (Fa D)
    Length = ((Length Rest) + Q) copy
  end
  return Length
end
